# Luna Dreyer Translation

> Luna Dreyer Translation is an Australian translation and facilitation agency for legal documents in Europe, founded by Heidelberg-trained translator Luna Dreyer. Works on powers of attorney, apostille processes, business translation, localisation, transcreation, proofreading, subtitling, transcription, typesetting, language liaison and accompaniment. Languages: German, English, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Catalan, and through collaborators Greek (including Cypriot Greek), Maltese and French. Does not provide NAATI-certified translations.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lunadreyer.com.au/): Overview of the agency's translation and facilitation services for Australians dealing with European authorities.
- [Services and pricing](https://lunadreyer.com.au/services.html): Ten services that do not require NAATI certification, with starting prices in AUD or a fixed quote.
- [About](https://lunadreyer.com.au/about.html): The agency, its founder Luna Dreyer, and its language team.
- [Power of attorney and apostille](https://lunadreyer.com.au/power-of-attorney-apostille-australia.html): How a power of attorney is drafted, translated, notarised and apostilled in Australia for use in Europe, in the correct order.
- [Buying property in Italy from Australia](https://lunadreyer.com.au/buying-property-italy-from-australia.html): The documents and process for Australians buying Italian property remotely, including judicial auctions.
- [Apostille in Australia](https://lunadreyer.com.au/apostille-australia.html): DFAT apostille process, fees, timeframes and which countries accept an Australian apostille.
- [Power of attorney for property in Greece](https://lunadreyer.com.au/power-of-attorney-property-greece.html): Why non-resident owners use a power of attorney for buying, managing, tax representation and document handling for Greek property.
- [Heidelberg](https://lunadreyer.com.au/heidelberg.html): Background on the founder's training at Heidelberg University and why it matters for legal translation.
- [Document translation](https://lunadreyer.com.au/translation-services.html): Document translation between Spanish and English, into English from German, Italian, Portuguese and Catalan, and Greek, Maltese and French through collaborators.
- [Per avvocati](https://lunadreyer.com.au/avvocati.html): Information in Italian for Italian lawyers coordinating a power of attorney with a client in Australia.
- [Ayuda en español](https://lunadreyer.com.au/ayuda-comunidad-latina.html): Information in Spanish for the Latino community in Australia: accompaniment and help with everyday tasks such as renewing a driving licence, booking a doctor, finding a tradesperson, and phone calls or forms in English, with an enquiry form.
- [Power of attorney guide for Italian property](https://lunadreyer.com.au/power-of-attorney-italy-property.html): Why overseas owners use a procura for an Italian property purchase or sale, the process, common mistakes, and choosing a representative.
- [Using an Australian power of attorney in Europe](https://lunadreyer.com.au/australian-power-of-attorney-europe.html): Why cross-border document recognition matters, what makes a POA suitable for international use, granting authority to a relative for an estate, and common pitfalls that delay recognition.
- [Managing Italian property and inheritance from Australia](https://lunadreyer.com.au/italian-property-inheritance-checklist.html): Legal checklist covering Italian succession rules, tax in Italy and Australia, required documents, and the Catasto land registry.
- [Articles](https://lunadreyer.com.au/articles.html): Index of in-depth articles on apostilles, powers of attorney and property overseas.
- [Get in touch](https://lunadreyer.com.au/contact.html): Contact form for enquiries; not NAATI-certified, works directly with European civil-law requirements instead.
